# climatekit

> Compute 35+ standard climate indices from daily weather observations. Install with `install.packages("climatekit")`.

Version: 0.1.0. License: MIT.

## Functions

- [`ck_available()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/climatekit/reference/ck_available.html): List All Available Climate Indices
- [`ck_branas()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/climatekit/reference/ck_branas.html): Branas Hydrothermal Index
- [`ck_compute()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/climatekit/reference/ck_compute.html): Compute a Climate Index by Name
- [`ck_convert_temp()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/climatekit/reference/ck_convert_temp.html): Convert Temperature Units
- [`ck_cooling_degree_days()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/climatekit/reference/ck_cooling_degree_days.html): Cooling Degree Days
- [`ck_diurnal_range()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/climatekit/reference/ck_diurnal_range.html): Diurnal Temperature Range
- [`ck_dry_days()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/climatekit/reference/ck_dry_days.html): Maximum Consecutive Dry Days
- [`ck_fire_danger()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/climatekit/reference/ck_fire_danger.html): Fire Danger Index (Simplified)
- [`ck_first_frost()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/climatekit/reference/ck_first_frost.html): First Frost Date
- [`ck_frost_days()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/climatekit/reference/ck_frost_days.html): Frost Days
- [`ck_growing_degree_days()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/climatekit/reference/ck_growing_degree_days.html): Growing Degree Days
- [`ck_growing_season()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/climatekit/reference/ck_growing_season.html): Growing Season Length
- [`ck_heat_index()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/climatekit/reference/ck_heat_index.html): Heat Index
- [`ck_heating_degree_days()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/climatekit/reference/ck_heating_degree_days.html): Heating Degree Days
- [`ck_heavy_precip()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/climatekit/reference/ck_heavy_precip.html): Heavy Precipitation Days
- [`ck_huglin()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/climatekit/reference/ck_huglin.html): Huglin Heliothermal Index
- [`ck_humidex()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/climatekit/reference/ck_humidex.html): Humidex
- [`ck_ice_days()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/climatekit/reference/ck_ice_days.html): Ice Days
- [`ck_last_frost()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/climatekit/reference/ck_last_frost.html): Last Frost Date
- [`ck_max_1day_precip()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/climatekit/reference/ck_max_1day_precip.html): Maximum 1-Day Precipitation
- [`ck_max_5day_precip()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/climatekit/reference/ck_max_5day_precip.html): Maximum 5-Day Precipitation
- [`ck_metadata()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/climatekit/reference/ck_metadata.html): Get Metadata for a Climate Index
- [`ck_pet()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/climatekit/reference/ck_pet.html): Potential Evapotranspiration (Hargreaves Method)
- [`ck_precip_intensity()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/climatekit/reference/ck_precip_intensity.html): Precipitation Intensity (SDII)
- [`ck_spei()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/climatekit/reference/ck_spei.html): Standardized Precipitation-Evapotranspiration Index (SPEI)
- [`ck_spi()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/climatekit/reference/ck_spi.html): Standardized Precipitation Index (SPI)
- [`ck_summer_days()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/climatekit/reference/ck_summer_days.html): Summer Days
- [`ck_total_precip()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/climatekit/reference/ck_total_precip.html): Total Precipitation
- [`ck_tropical_nights()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/climatekit/reference/ck_tropical_nights.html): Tropical Nights
- [`ck_very_heavy_precip()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/climatekit/reference/ck_very_heavy_precip.html): Very Heavy Precipitation Days
- [`ck_warm_spell()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/climatekit/reference/ck_warm_spell.html): Warm Spell Days
- [`ck_wet_days()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/climatekit/reference/ck_wet_days.html): Maximum Consecutive Wet Days
- [`ck_wind_chill()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/climatekit/reference/ck_wind_chill.html): Wind Chill Temperature
- [`ck_winkler()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/climatekit/reference/ck_winkler.html): Winkler Index
- [`clear_cache()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/climatekit/reference/clear_cache.html): Clear Cache

## Documentation

- [Full reference](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/climatekit/reference/)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/charlescoverdale/climatekit)
